docs.summary: Headset controller and hand input while [`XR`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.XR) is running. Everything reads as released, zero and untracked when it is not, or when the application does not have input focus in the headset.
Whether the controller in `hand` is being tracked.
Whether a controller is in use in `hand`, as far as the runtime knows.
The OpenXR interaction profile the runtime uses for the controller in `hand`, such as `/interaction_profiles/oculus/touch_controller`, or empty when there is none.
Raised when a controller is picked up, put down or swapped for another kind.
How far the trigger is pulled, from 0 to 1.
How hard the grip is squeezed, from 0 to 1. Controllers with a grip button report 0 or 1.
